classification: Finite laboratory simulation holdout fixed without R24 candidate output; not safety qualification, hardware evidence, hidden production evaluation, or original course demo.
selection: New interpolation points, loaded-transfer normals, off-axis shocks, near-spaced pairs, tool offsets, and mechanics were fixed independently of any R24 candidate selection or result.

qualification.absolute_protection: Zero candidate false rise, zero false active sample outside registered impulse/tool intervals, zero duplicate rise in every event slot, and loaded-transfer normal silence.
qualification.baseline_floor: Preserve every strict R23 FREE event and real-tool detection within 5 ms, with no greater alarm-sample cost than R23 plus five samples on preserved strict slots.
qualification.scoped_detection: Exactly one attributable candidate rise with a 25 ms quiet prefix for every intended isolated and both-impulse slot.
qualification.positive_gain: Candidate-only strict slots are reported separately and never establish safety qualification.
